verdict.rationale: SigNoz calls itself an OpenTelemetry-native platform. Its docs show apps exporting telemetry over OTLP straight into SigNoz, and logs coming in via OpenTelemetry SDKs; community users confirm the OpenTelemetry basis. However, the explicit OTLP-export evidence sits in the LLM-observability context, and general OTLP ingestion details are not documented in the pack. missing for 10: general OTLP endpoint docs (gRPC/HTTP ports, auth/ingestion keys), explicit OTLP ingestion for traces and metrics outside the LLM use case, hands-on corroboration of direct OTLP export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Your application emits gen_ai.* spans and metrics through standard OpenTelemetry libraries, exports them over OTLP, and SigNoz stores and queries them next to the rest of your application telemetry.
SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform.
